study type: Retrospective ancillary analysis of a prospective perinatal intervention trial
exposure: Variations in obstetric practice between hospitals
cohort: 660 nulliparous women with uncomplicated singleton term pregnancies at two Australian tertiary obstetric units
finding: Higher rates of forceps delivery were associated with a higher incidence of LAM avulsion and composite trauma in one hospital compared to the other.
mod_finding: Forceps delivery was a significant predictor of both LAM avulsion and composite trauma.
